title: Automaton 솔로 #001 · super hourglass · 황동 녹청 관절 · 양팔 들기 · 대나무 숲 · 글래스 스킨
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long straight honey blonde hair — full body polished brass clockwork automaton fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid polished brass automaton body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into fitted brass plates, with one huge round cut-out window across her chest and belly as wide as her whole torso, showing a dense tangle of meshing gears of many sizes packed edge to edge inside a deep hollow cavity lit from within by a soft warm glow, stacked in layers at different depths with light pale-gold gaps between the layers so every gear on every layer is clearly visible, one giant gear as wide as her ribcage surrounded by medium and small gears, coiled springs and steel shafts, all turning together, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every plate ends in a round exposed hinge joint with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted plates — BLAZING warm polished brass plates across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID silver gears with large red ruby bearings at their centres turning inside the cut-out window, deep blue-green verdigris joints standing out sharply against the brass, a large brass wind-up key as long as her forearm turning slowly at her side, bright polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of the same polished brass, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same polished brass with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the automaton body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: dewy skin with a light highlighter on the cheekbones, a soft peach blush, juicy peach-tinted lips.

Background: a bright bamboo grove with a smooth stone path, tall green bamboo on both sides, a waist-high bamboo fence and a standard gate, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
